Bailey Hall Model Renders

Two-dimensional, to-scale model of Bailey Hall built from the CMCM 2026 evacuation plans and chair layouts: 1,329 seats, orchestra, loge, corridor, foyer and balcony. Scale 3.92 px/ft on the plans; coordinates in feet, stage north.
